logic.par.text:
to trail_permit_score with day_hikers as number, overnight_hikers as number, trail_guides as number, storm_alert as yesno giving number:
    let required be day_hikers times 5 plus overnight_hikers times 12
    if storm_alert:
        set required to required plus trail_guides times 6
    let capacity be trail_guides times 38
    let admitted be required
    if admitted is more than capacity:
        set admitted to capacity
    let waiting be required minus capacity
    if waiting is less than 0:
        set waiting to 0
    give back admitted plus waiting times 6

main.par.text:
include "logic.par"
a web_request has method as text, path as text, query as text, headers as map from text to text, body as text
a request_input has permit_code as text, day_hikers as number, overnight_hikers as number, trail_guides as number, storm_alert as yesno
a response_body has permit_code as text, visitor_total as number, trail_units as number, guide_capacity_units as number, admitted_units as number, waiting_units as number, permit_score as number, permit_state as text
a controlled_response has status as number, headers as map from text to text, body as response_body
a service_status has service as text, ready as yesno
to project_status giving service_status:
    give back a service_status with service "Trail Permit", ready yes
to empty_body with key as text, state as text giving response_body:
    give back a response_body with permit_code key, visitor_total 0, trail_units 0, guide_capacity_units 0, admitted_units 0, waiting_units 0, permit_score 0, permit_state state
to handle_request with request as web_request, body as request_input giving controlled_response:
    let headers be a map from text to text
    let credential be (maybe item "authorization" of request's headers) otherwise ""
    if credential is not "Bearer trail-045":
        set item "www-authenticate" of headers to "Bearer realm=trail-permit"
        give back a controlled_response with status 401, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's permit_code, "authorization_required")
    if body's day_hikers is less than 0:
        set item "x-validation" of headers to "nonnegative"
        give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's permit_code, "invalid")
    if body's overnight_hikers is less than 0:
        set item "x-validation" of headers to "nonnegative"
        give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's permit_code, "invalid")
    if body's trail_guides is less than 0:
        set item "x-validation" of headers to "nonnegative"
        give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's permit_code, "invalid")
    if body's trail_guides is 0:
        if body's day_hikers plus body's overnight_hikers is more than 0:
            set item "x-validation" of headers to "trail_guides"
            give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's permit_code, "invalid")
    let total be body's day_hikers plus body's overnight_hikers
    let required be body's day_hikers times 5 plus body's overnight_hikers times 12
    if body's storm_alert:
        set required to required plus body's trail_guides times 6
    let capacity be body's trail_guides times 38
    let admitted be required
    if admitted is more than capacity:
        set admitted to capacity
    let waiting be required minus capacity
    if waiting is less than 0:
        set waiting to 0
    let state be "issued"
    if waiting is more than 0:
        set state to "routine_queue"
        if body's storm_alert:
            set state to "storm_queue"
    let result be a response_body with permit_code body's permit_code, visitor_total total, trail_units required, guide_capacity_units capacity, admitted_units admitted, waiting_units waiting, permit_score (trail_permit_score with body's day_hikers, body's overnight_hikers, body's trail_guides, body's storm_alert), permit_state state
    set item "x-permit-state" of headers to "{state}"
    give back a controlled_response with status 200, headers headers, body result
